UPDATE search_events
                     SET query = ?, filters = ?, query_vec = ?, vec_dim = ?,
                         embed_model = ?, created_at = ?, answered = ?, skips = 0,
                         generation_id = (SELECT id FROM generations WHERE state = 'live'
                                           ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1)
                     WHERE id = ?
